decision.rationale: Reproducible identity defect: every dispatch unconditionally assigns a newly created object to selectionHandle.value. Therefore an unrelated set-note action and an idempotent select of the current ID both replace the exact current selection-handle reference, violating BG-H03-INV-HANDLE-IDENTITY. The changed reference also retriggers the effect keyed by selectionHandle.value and increments previewAttachmentCount.
